item.title: Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting: Trump's recognition of China and Russia as 'peers of the US'
item.description: Genie Godula is pleased to welcome Olivia Cheung. The trilateral meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit was significant despite the absence of concrete agreements, according to Cheung. “The significance is seen in the precedence of the United States seeing and giving recognition that China and Russia are peers of the United States,” she explained, adding that “the image of a G3 is very significant.”

item.title: NASA's Voyager 1 phones home from record one light-day away, 49 years after launch
item.description: The Voyager 1 probe launched by NASA nearly a half century ago has reached a distance from Earth of one light day (more than 26 billion kilometres), the farthest any human artifact has ever ventured from our planet. The space agency received a signal from the spacecraft Thursday, exactly 24 hours after it was sent.

item.title: French media regulator says it will monitor top YouTubers for bias in election coverage
item.description: Rules designed to safeguard media pluralism during elections campaigns will apply to France's most influential YouTubers in the run-up to next year's presidential contest, media regulator Arcom warned on Thursday, reflecting the growing influence of content creators whose audiences often outstrip those of traditional media companies.

item.title: What impact will the Shenzhen summit have on the US-China trade war?
item.description: Despite warm words between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen Thursday, the simmering trade war between Washington and Beijing still looks to be no closer to resolution.

item.title: Bangladesh: Hasina supporters vandalise ruling party office
item.description: Hundreds of supporters of ousted Bangladesh premier Sheikh Hasina staged street protests on Thursday, as a wave of arson attacks escalated tensions ahead of her planned return from exile next month.
